author: jracer15
body:
I spent a month making Mt. Blizzard.  I didn't even think anyone would like it but I submitted it anyways just because I liked the map.  It gets good reviews and is accepted for testing.  I take a week notice and still no one test it. I ask why hasn't been tested yet, they say a map dev who does most walls stuff test them and is not present.  I ask why not you, they reply they don't understand walls fully.  I understand so I decide to ask someone else.  Now it has been two weeks and I realize that other maps that are submitted, tested, and accecpted before my map.  Now I don't think its unfair I have to wait this long and other map makers don't.  I'm all for waiting but only when I get a fairly same wait time as others and if I can get an actual time of when the map is tested.  Why am I even making this post?  Because my map was denied basically for asking why I had to wait two weeks and someone else waited 2-3 days.  I think its unfair to use your capabilities as map devs to deny my map because I "pester" but I was not in the loop of when it was going to be tested.


I suggest if a map is approved for testing that there should an actual date saved for it to be tested so there is no more questions.  I'm sorry to bother the map dev community but I ask 3 map devs and they all said they would the next day and only 1 was going to until it was denied for this disrespectful reason.

title: Hear me Out Map Devs

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
The reason your map took so long to be tested was because of the fact that it's a walls map. I don't have much knowledge of walls maps, so when you asked me, I told you just that. I'm not sure if other mapdevs have a lot of knowledge of walls maps, but to my understanding Polar is the walls expert and he is on leave. It's just best to wait for him to get back for a more "accurate" review. I've seen mapdevs complaining in our slack chat about you pestering us about your map. You were warned to stop asking and wait for polar (I think, if not you should have been).

As for your suggestion... It's just better to test a map on the fly, but I guess that could work

replies.author: jracer15
replies.body: I was actually never warned about "pestering". I usually got The answer "I would test it tomorrow" and then they don't.

replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body: Just as a side note, my first map took at least a month or two to get tested properly, and I didn't get a reply on whether it would go into rots or not 4 months later. I waited all that time without bugging the MapDevs.

replies.author: jracer15
replies.body: Map Devs are cool.  But I was never told I was bickering them.  If someone told me I was bother than this was a different story.  I was either told "I don't understand walls to test them" or "I'll test it tomorrow" So it seemed like things were going well...

replies.body: When I talked to Zink it seemed like we were having a nice conversation about this.  In fact we spent most of the time talking about other maps.  So I don't think see how asking about it to different map devs was a pestering.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
As Pavlo said, it takes some time for maps to get tested. I'll take a direct quote, "my first map took at least a month or two to get tested properly, and I didn;t get a reply on whether it would go into rots or not 4 months later".

As this shows, please be more patient, even we are currently busy with other work in the map development area. And about, "I was either told "I don't understand walls to test them" or "I'll test it tomorrow" So it seemed like things were going well...". Sorry about that, things kinda changed up.

Next time, please try and be patient.
